summary: Phase 4 frontend integration is complete and production-ready. All 20 tasks from phase4-plan.md are implemented: types, services, utilities, loading components, GitHub OAuth with popup blocker detection, repository import with progress polling and cleanup guards, semantic search with debouncing and mounted guards, AI page tabs, code block rendering with clipboard API checks, comprehensive documentation. Build passes (npm run build), lint passes with only non-blocking warnings (expected React patterns), all routes configured (/github/callback public, /github and /ai/:projectId? protected for CANDIDATE/RECRUITER), responsive layouts work at 480px/768px/1024px breakpoints. Iteration 1 findings (8 issues: mounted guards, popup blocker feedback, clipboard API checks, projects loading, responsive modal width) were all addressed in fix commit 9f37fcc and verified in iteration 2. No blocking issues remain.
